subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: A `currency-disposition/v1` record shall be a closed, versioned, committed datum covering exactly one stale edge and declaring: unique disposition id; author principal; edge kind `design_dependency` or `requirement_service`; feature and subject design; superseded target; one current live replacement target; a non-empty exact old-to-new binding mapping; conformance-evidence references; subject, old target, replacement target, cited-binding, mapping-set, and policy fingerprints; and one typed reference to a separate closed approval attestation. The projection shall compute a canonical disposition-record fingerprint without self-reference. The attestation shall bind that disposition id and computed fingerprint, exact edge, mapping-set digest, `compatible` verdict, explicit complete-scope and no-known-contradiction assertions, authenticated human reviewer principal distinct from the author, approval-authority policy id and fingerprint, and evidence reference. Wildcard, range, whole-document, empty, and multi-edge claims are forbidden.
rationale: the independent human review is the authority for which predecessor bindings were actually consumed; the gate validates that exact judgment rather than pretending the whole-document `Builds-on` edge already exposes a machine completeness oracle
fit_criterion: schema fixtures accept both complete variants and reject every unknown key, missing field, unknown enum, empty/multi-edge/wildcard/range/document-level mapping, absent live replacement, non-human or author-equal reviewer, non-compatible verdict, false scope assertions, or separate attestation not bound to the exact disposition/edge/mapping/policy fingerprints; fingerprint fixtures prove canonical non-self-referential reproduction
